name: Docker Browser Build & Test

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
      - beta
      - release
    paths:
      - 'Dockerfile.browser'
      - '.dockerignore'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'yarn.lock'
      - 'tsconfig.json'
      - 'events/**'
      - 'src/**'
      - 'test/**'
      - '.github/workflows/docker-browser.yml'
  schedule:
    # Biweekly: 1st and 15th of each month at 2:00 AM UTC
    - cron: '0 2 1,15 * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  REGISTRY: ghcr.io
  IMAGE_NAME: ${{ github.repository_owner }}/mqtt-explorer
  DOCKERFILE: Dockerfile.browser

permissions:
  contents: read
  packages: write
  id-token: write
  attestations: write

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        platform:
          - linux/amd64
          - linux/arm64
          - linux/arm/v7

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up QEMU
        uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@v3

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Log in to the Container registry
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Extract metadata (tags, labels) for Docker
        id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
        with:
          images: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}
          tags: |
            type=ref,event=branch
            type=ref,event=pr
            type=sha,prefix=
            type=raw,value=latest,enable={{is_default_branch}}
            type=schedule,pattern={{date 'YYYY-MM-DD'}}

      - name: Build Docker image (single platform for testing)
        id: build
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: .
          file: ${{ env.DOCKERFILE }}
          platforms: ${{ matrix.platform }}
          push: false
          load: true
          tags: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:test-${{ matrix.platform }}
          labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max

      - name: Start Mosquitto MQTT Broker
        run: |
          docker run -d --name mosquitto -p 1883:1883 -p 9001:9001 eclipse-mosquitto:latest

      - name: Start MQTT Explorer Container
        run: |
          docker run -d --name mqtt-explorer \
            -p 8080:8080 \
            -e MQTT_BROKER_HOST=host.docker.internal \
            -e MQTT_BROKER_PORT=1883 \
            --network host \
            ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:test-${{ matrix.platform }}

      - name: Wait for container to be healthy
        run: |
          sleep 10
          for i in {1..10}; do
            if curl -f http://localhost:8080/health; then
              echo "Container is healthy"
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "Waiting for container to be healthy..."
            sleep 5
          done
          echo "Container failed to become healthy"
          exit 1

      - name: Run Smoke Tests
        run: |
          echo "Testing HTTP Response..."
          curl -f http://localhost:8080/
          
          echo "Testing Health Check..."
          curl -f http://localhost:8080/health

      - name: Run UI Tests (Browser Mode)
        uses: cypress-io/github-action@v6
        with:
          start: yarn test:browser
          wait-on: 'http://localhost:8080'
          wait-on-timeout: 120
          browser: chrome
          headed: false
        env:
          MQTT_BROKER_HOST: host.docker.internal
          MQTT_BROKER_PORT: 1883

      - name: Report Image Size
        run: |
          IMAGE_SIZE=$(docker image inspect ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:test-${{ matrix.platform }} --format='{{.Size}}')
          echo "Image size for ${{ matrix.platform }}: $((IMAGE_SIZE / 1024 / 1024)) MB" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY

      - name: Cleanup
        if: always()
        run: |
          docker stop mqtt-explorer mosquitto || true
          docker rm mqtt-explorer mosquitto || true

  publish:
    needs: build-and-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name != 'schedule' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up QEMU
        uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@v3

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Log in to the Container registry
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Extract metadata (tags, labels) for Docker
        id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
        with:
          images: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}
          tags: |
            type=ref,event=branch
            type=ref,event=pr
            type=sha,prefix=
            type=raw,value=latest,enable={{is_default_branch}}
            type=schedule,pattern={{date 'YYYY-MM-DD'}}

      - name: Build and push Docker image
        id: push
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: .
          file: ${{ env.DOCKERFILE }}
          platforms: linux/amd64,linux/arm64,linux/arm/v7
          push: true
          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
          labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max

      - name: Generate artifact attestation
        uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@v1
        with:
          subject-name: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}
          subject-digest: ${{ steps.push.outputs.digest }}
          push-to-registry: true

      - name: Scan Docker image
        uses: anchore/scan-action@1638637db639e0ade3258b51db49a9a137574c3e
        with:
          image: ${{ env.REGISTRY }}/${{ env.IMAGE_NAME }}:${{ github.sha }}
          severity-cutoff: critical
          fail-build: true
